compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: orenr@moveo.co.il
We are not compliant with HIPAA as we do not store private
As an app without UI we only need to re-direct the user to monday.com for authentication purposes.

We leverage GraphQL with robustly typed models to modify data, ensuring anything sent to the strongly typed attributes is disregarded. Additionally, we employ DTOs (Data Transfer Objects) for efficient data management.
All code Pull Requests undergo an approval process that includes examining the log content. The team also uses methods to obscure any data that might contain confidential details.
multi-factor authentication is enforced on employees on all the systems which processes/hold customer data (Mongo DB, AWS)
Only the Support and Development team leads have restricted access to customer data.

Yes, our app employs encoding and sanitization on all user-supplied parameters to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. Using Node.js with the Express framework as our backend, we utilize the mongo-sanitize package to sanitize all incoming requests. This approach ensures that any potentially malicious input is appropriately filtered and encoded to prevent XSS vulnerabilities.

By incorporating this sanitization step in our request handling process, we provide a secure environment and minimize the risk of XSS attacks, thereby safeguarding both our application and user data.
Not relevant

Our app is hosted in AWS, includes an alarm and monitoring system designed to alert the development team in the event of a security breach. The system continuously monitors our application and infrastructure, and if it detects any suspicious activity or potential breach, it triggers an alarm to notify the team immediately.

Once alerted, the development team can quickly investigate the issue, take corrective action, and inform monday.com of the breach if necessary. This proactive approach helps ensure that potential threats are addressed swiftly to minimize impact on our service and customers.

Our service utilizes Dependabot to manage application-level updates and security patches for our software packages and databases. Dependabot automatically checks for updates and generates pull requests for package dependencies, including both application-level updates and security patches.

For critical and high-severity updates, we prioritize immediate action. Once Dependabot identifies these updates, our team promptly reviews and applies them to maintain the security and stability of our service.

For other, lower-priority updates, we manage them on a scheduled basis. Our team reviews and applies these updates at regular intervals to ensure that the service remains up-to-date while balancing resource allocation and operational continuity.
We separate data by including an account id field in all entities and applying filters based on it for all requests

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: ActionLink shares selected monday.com data to client-facing portals you create; only the fields you choose to expose (e.g., item/ subitem names, statuses, dates, numbers, files if enabled, and client comments/updates). It also transmits limited metadata needed to operate the portals and audit access (e.g., account/board/item IDs, portal/user IDs, request logs like IP/user-agent). This is inherent to providing external client dashboards/links and follows monday’s app privacy requirements to document any third-party domains used.
Logs are stored on our dedicated Digital Ocean server protected by multi-factor authentication. Logs are additionally redacted of sensitive information before being stored/logged.
We use secure, encrypted Digital Ocean DBs.
Users can contact will@actionlink.app at any time with security/privacy requests.
The app never redirects to any destination outside of the app.

We never auto-bind request bodies to models; each endpoint uses explicit allow-lists/DTO schemas and server-side validation, unknown fields are ignored/stripped, and sensitive attributes (e.g., roles/ownership/billing/status) are treated as read-only and not writeable via the API.
PIIs are redacted via a middleware in the logger and are never printed or stored.
The database is protected via multi-factor authentication.
Yes. We work based on least necessary privilege and access principle.
Yes. React auto-escapes values in JSX; when we intentionally render HTML we sanitize it (e.g., DOMPurify); and we enforce a Content-Security-Policy.

Yes. All state-changing routes are CSRF-protected: we require per-request CSRF tokens (per OWASP guidance), verify Origin/Referer on unsafe methods, and use SameSite cookies. Where the API uses bearer tokens in the Authorization header (not cookies), requests aren’t automatically sent by the browser, which prevents CSRF by design.
Yes; We will notify monday.com and our users in case of a security breach and put our systems in panic mode.

Yes. We follow a documented patch/update process: prioritize and apply patches per NIST SP 800-40, aligned with CIS Control 7 and OWASP ASVS; automate dependency security updates (Dependabot PRs) and rebuild/redeploy base images; and keep managed databases on scheduled maintenance windows with automatic minor-version security upgrades.
Customer data is segregated logically based on monday account id.

Create powerful formulas directly in your widgets! Native number widgets don't offer this functionality - but we've got you covered!


What You Can Do

  • Create custom formulas using up to 5 dynamic numbers from your boards
  • Perform basic mathematical operations (+, -, *, /)
  • Display results in your preferred format ($, €, %, custom)
  • Elevate visual presentation with customizable font and background colors
  • Add conditional coloring rules to display values in different colors based on thresholds


How It Works

Simply add dynamic numbers in the widget settings (similar to native Monday widgets) and configure each number's source by selecting specific boards, groups, and columns. Once set up, reference your numbers in the formula by writing their name in curly brackets (e.g., {REVENUE}) - just like in formula columns. Additionally, you can customize the appearance with color settings and formatting options.


Perfect For

  • Calculating totals across different groups
  • Computing averages from multiple sources
  • Determining percentages
  • Creating custom KPI displays
  • And much more!

🔍 Ready to Start?

Check out our How to use page to get started with your first formula widget in minutes!

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: While Dashboard Formula Widget hasn't undergone separate ISO 27001 certification, it operates entirely within monday.com's infrastructure which is ISO 27001 certified. Since we rely exclusively on monday.com's certified environment for all data processing and storage, customers benefit from monday.com's security certifications and protocols when using our app.

Dashboard Formula Widget operates entirely within the monday.com environment. All formula data, user settings, and calculations are processed and stored exclusively within monday.com's infrastructure. We do not transmit any data to external servers or third-party services.

We utilize monday.com's native logging system for any necessary error tracking. This approach ensures that all logs remain within the monday.com ecosystem, maintaining data sovereignty and eliminating the need for external logging services.
All app data is stored exclusively in monday.com's storage. We do not use third-party databases or external storage services, ensuring the security and confidentiality of your data.
Yes, we have a dedicated point of contact for security and privacy inquiries at support@roba-solutions.com. Our team responds promptly to all security concerns or privacy questions.

Our application isn't directly subject to HIPAA regulations as we don't store any sensitive information within our own system. Instead, all data is securely housed and managed through the monday.com platform, which fully complies with HIPAA requirements. By leveraging monday.com for data storage, we ensure that all user information is handled in accordance with HIPAA standards.

While Dashboard Formula Widget itself has not undergone independent SOC 2 or SOC 3 certification, it operates exclusively within monday.com's infrastructure, which maintains these certifications. We do not operate separate servers or databases that would require additional certification. By relying on monday.com's certified platform for all data processing and storage, our app maintains the security and compliance standards established by monday.com's SOC certifications.

Dashboard Formula Widget processes and stores data exclusively within the monday.com environment and uses only minimal read permissions. Since we do not process or store personal data outside the monday.com platform, we benefit from the GDPR compliance of the monday.com infrastructure.

Yes, Dashboard Formula Widget is protected against mass parameter assignment attacks. Users cannot directly edit or add parameters. Instead, the app generates a predefined selection from which users can only choose via checkboxes. This ensures that only authorized parameters can be used.

Yes, we ensure our logs do not contain personally identifiable information or sensitive data. Our logging practice is limited to technical error information (e.g., API errors when retrieving data) and contains no user data.

Yes, we strictly follow the principle of least privilege. Dashboard Formula Widget only requests the OAuth scope "board:read," which represents the minimum permissions required for functionality. We never access more data than necessary for our app's core functionality.

Yes, Dashboard Formula Widget implements comprehensive sanitization of all user inputs. We enforce character limits and our validation functions prevent malicious code injection. Input data is properly validated before being stored in the monday.com storage system, ensuring protection against XSS attacks.
Yes, we have a clear process for promptly notifying monday.com in the unlikely event of a security breach to ensure quick and appropriate responses.
Yes, by using the monday.com storage system, data separation between different customers is automatically ensured. This provides secure logical separation of customer data.

glenn.coward@capabilitysource.com

The parameters for the database sync are assigned within the application itself, no user input affects them. They have hardcoded specific columns that they are updating. Our forms on the frontend have only specific fields to be updated as well.
We are using only generic error messages, and not specific secrets, request data or response data for error messages
No one has access to customer data since we are not storing any customer data in our service.
In React.js all of the inputs are sanitized by default, the only problem occurs when the app is using dangerouslySetInnerHTML, which we are not using.

The only state changing request that a user can trigger are the ones modifiying their monday.com instance/workspaces/boards. Here we are using the short lived token from the trigger output or the token from the sdk on the frontend. As such they are both verified with their signing and client secrets before initiating any modifications, and behaving as CSRF tokens in that matter.
We would contact monday.com immediately through an email and describe the situtation and our next steps in resolving the issue.

marketplace_apps.description:
You're building a workflow in monday.com and you hit a wall.  

Column Clone & Sync lets you move data between any column types in monday.com - instantly.


Formula results that need to be in a date column? Done. Mirror values you need in automations? Done. Timeline dates you need split into separate columns? Done. It just works.


CCS runs as a column extension — not an automation. Setup takes up to 5 seconds. Open the column menu, pick your source, pick your target, choose copy or sync. That's it.


33 source column types. 9 target types. The broadest column support on the marketplace.


⚡ WHAT YOU CAN DO:


✅ Mirror → copies to all 9 target types. Use mirror data in automations, formulas, and filters — no more read-only dead ends.

✅ Formula → dates, numbers, text, status. Formula results finally land where you need them — including date columns.

✅ Timeline → date columns. Extract start and end dates in seconds.

✅ Connected Boards → text. Pull connected board values into usable, editable columns.

✅ Plus Status, People, Tags, Dropdown, Email, Phone, and 23 more source types.


🔧 HOW IT WORKS:


1. Open the target column menu

2. Select Column Clone & Sync

3. Choose your source column

4. Pick Copy or Sync

5. Done - up to 5 seconds.


While other apps are still on step 1 of building an automation, you're already finished.


🔄 COPY OR SYNC - YOUR CHOICE:

Copy values once for a quick transfer, or keep columns synced automatically as data changes. Same simple setup for both modes.


🏆 ONE APP, NOT FOUR:

Instead of installing separate tools for formula triggers, mirror syncing, timeline conversion, and column copying — Column Copy & Sync handles all of it. One install. One price.


🔒 BUILT ON MONDAY.COM'S SECURE PLATFORM:

CCS runs entirely within monday.com's infrastructure. Your data never leaves the platform. Enterprise-grade security, compliance, and permissions — built in from day one.


🚀 GET STARTED NOW:

Experience the benefits firsthand — install the app and streamline your workflow.


For a personalized walkthrough or any questions, book a call with our team or reach out to our support at support@lupapps.io.

Oboard's OKR monday app allows you to move past time-consuming spreadsheets or the basic monday OKR template. It offers a user-friendly interface and robust features to ensure your team is aligned and ready to achieve strategic goals.

  • Outcome-focused Management: Keep teams aligned with actionable insights and comprehensive performance reports.
  • Private Workspaces: Manage data-sensitive projects with secure access controls.
  • Flexibility in OKR setup. Adapt the app to your needs, from adjustable OKR levels, confidence levels, and cycles to custom OKR fields.
  • Web app: monday.com Admins can invite external users who are not part of their monday.com instance. These users will gain access to the Web version of OKR Board, enabling them to collaborate on the same OKRs.

Trusted by over 3,000 companies worldwide, Oboard has already helped customers build more than 100,000 OKRs. Its flexibility accommodates businesses of all sizes, making it the ideal tool for building a collaborative and outcome-driven culture.

ReactJS encodes all inputs before they are injected into the DOM.

marketplace_apps.description:
Online Planning Poker for distributed teams - launch now and have fun with remotely estimating stories

Fun to work with, lots of voting options

Different ways to achieve agreement on the estimation through Regular cards, Fibonacci sequences, T-Shirt cards, Free Scale both for story points and time.

Real-time chat and micro polls

The extension adds real-time chat capabilities to monday.com. Additionally, micro-polls with up/down voting and likes can be created on each chat message to collect opinionated view and mood among the participants.

Customizable appearance

Layout can be customised to your preference. Color scheme, sound volume and card appearance can be adjusted as you like them most.

More details

Scrumpy Poker is an online planning poker application for distributed agile teams with multiple integrations. It runs on mobile, tablet and desktop computers connecting multiple participants in a real-time story estimation session.

  • Real-time collaboration between your employees, contractors and guests, including the monday.com viewers!
  • Operational on any device
  • Supports Mobile for members and guests
  • Regular, Fibonacci, T-Shirt cards with custom story points
  • Estimate with story points and time with cards or a slider
  • Automatically updates item's story points or time
  • Asynchronous and real-time voting
  • Timers for the voting and refinement session
  • Chat
  • Polls

Planning and refinement sessions must be fun, keep everyone involved and provoke collaboration during the estimation. The Scrumpy Poker online application is a great tool for your planning meetings!

Try now and have fun on Scrumpy Poker's Playground without installing!

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer:
The app may transmit limited data necessary to enable the Trello embedding and synchronization experience. This can include customer-submitted content such as Trello board URLs or embedded board references, along with limited non-customer-submitted identifiers required for integration functionality.

Board access, synchronization, rendering, and authentication are handled through Trello and Atlassian systems. We do not store or persist customer board content on our own servers beyond what is required for the app’s operational functionality.
We are using logging services provided by monday.com.
We are using storage services provided by monday.com. Any minimal configuration or metadata required for embedding and synchronization is stored within monday.com infrastructure.

Yes. We have a dedicated security and privacy point of contact for inquiries and incident-related communications.

Security & Privacy Contact: Serena Hagen (Data Protection Officer) serena@<satisfactiondrivers.com>. Please remove "<" & ">" before sending email.

Yes. We operate the app in a GDPR-aligned manner and apply privacy-by-design principles. The app is designed to minimize data processing and does not persist customer board content within our own systems beyond operational requirements necessary to provide the integration.

Access to Trello content remains governed by the customer’s Trello and Atlassian authentication and sharing permissions. We implement appropriate access controls, data minimization practices, and incident response procedures consistent with GDPR expectations.

We also maintain a dedicated privacy contact, Serena Hagen (Data Protection Officer, Serena@<satisfactiondrivers.com>), for GDPR and privacy-related inquiries.

Yes, redirect behavior is restricted. The app does not implement user-controlled redirects or forwarding to arbitrary external destinations. Any external navigation is limited to approved Trello, Atlassian, and Satisfaction Drivers resources and is presented as explicit user actions rather than automatic redirects.

For the Trello integration specifically, authentication and board access flows are handled through Trello / Atlassian authentication systems and are outside our direct control. We do not introduce additional redirect paths beyond what is required for the embedded Trello experience.

Yes. We protect against mass parameter assignment by accepting only explicitly allowlisted parameters and rejecting unexpected or unsupported fields. Server-side validation is enforced for all requests.

Because the app operates as an embedded monday.com integration, additional controls are also enforced by the hosting platform. For Trello-related actions, board-level permissions and authorization enforcement are primarily handled through Trello and Atlassian access controls.

Yes. We intentionally minimize logging and avoid storing sensitive information, including credentials, access tokens, customer board content, or personally identifiable information (PII), within application logs.

Logs are restricted to operational and technical events required for monitoring, reliability, and troubleshooting. We also do not use third-party session replay or screen capture tools that record user screens, keystrokes, or board content.

Yes. We require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for employee access to systems that may process customer data, including cloud infrastructure, administrative tooling, and source control systems. Access is additionally governed through least-privilege principles.

For Trello and Atlassian content, MFA enforcement depends on the customer’s Atlassian authentication configuration and is administered by the customer’s Atlassian administrator.

Yes. We enforce least-privilege access controls for employee and system access to operational and support environments. Access is limited to authorized personnel and granted only when necessary for support, maintenance, or security purposes.

We do not store or persist Trello board content in our systems. Access to Trello content remains protected through the customer’s Trello and Atlassian authentication and sharing permissions. Additionally, we do not use session replay or screen-recording tools that capture customer board content or user activity.

Yes. The app treats all user-supplied input as untrusted and applies validation, sanitization, and context-aware output encoding to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). We do not render raw user input as executable HTML or JavaScript.

Because the app embeds Trello content, some rendering and browser isolation protections are additionally managed by Trello, Atlassian, and the embedding environment.

Yes. All state-changing actions are protected against CSRF using standard protections appropriate to the request flow, including anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookie protections where applicable, authentication validation, and request integrity checks such as Origin and Referer verification.

As the app operates within monday.com and integrates with Trello, certain authentication and session protections are additionally enforced by monday.com and Trello authentication systems.

Yes. We maintain an incident response and escalation process that includes notification procedures for security events impacting the app, customer data, or the monday.com platform.

If a relevant security incident occurs, we will promptly notify monday.com through the appropriate channels and provide available details regarding scope, impact, containment, mitigation, and remediation progress. Internal logging and investigation procedures are maintained to support timely response and resolution.

Yes. We maintain a documented process for managing application updates and security patches across dependencies, infrastructure, and supporting services. Security advisories are monitored continuously, patches are prioritized based on severity and exposure, and updates are deployed through controlled testing and release procedures.

Critical security updates are expedited, and deployment workflows include validation and rollback mechanisms where appropriate.

Yes. Customer data is logically segregated through monday.com account boundaries, Trello workspace permissions, and application-level access controls to prevent unauthorized cross-customer access.

Additionally, we do not maintain persistent copies of customer board content within our own infrastructure, reducing the risk of cross-customer data exposure outside the monday.com and Trello environments.

Reports are easy to configure using the familiar monday.com automations interface - no onboarding, no time-consuming scanning through logs, and no extra licenses for clients, executives, or external partners.


Key benefits

✅ Custom Reports - Build flexible reports with custom triggers, choose which columns to include, define the reporting period, and customize the email body

✅ Time Savings - Skip the activity log hassle and get clear XLS reports sent straight to your inbox

✅ Effortless Sharing - Share reports with anyone, even without monday account

✅ Custom Reports On Demand - Need something specific? Our team can build tailored reports for your use case


Project (board) level reports:

  • Status changes report + Time in Status report
  • Budget, cost, or revenue updates
  • Overdue tasks
  • Time tracking changes
  • New tasks

Item level reports:

  • Last updates report
  • Last updates by user


👉Check out our new Interactive Gantt Timeline app

Project Leads

Executives

Team Members

  • Locate important attachments and key decisions

Finance & Operations

  • Keep track of budget adjustments

External Partners & Clients

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: We store app logs in monday-code Logger.
The app data is stored at 2 places. All the secrets and tokens are stored in monday-code Secrets Manager and Secure Storage. And all the file copy information is stored in Azure Table Storage.
apps@cloudvandana.com
Copy Files Pro is not typically subject to HIPAA requirements because our operations do not involve the storage or processing of protected health information.
Copy Files Pro secures navigation by allowing redirects only to pre-approved URLs.
Copy Files Pro secures data by strictly filtering user inputs, preventing mass parameter assignment attacks.
We ensure that the app does not log any of the secrets, tokens, or API keys. We only log account Id and type of action performed.
We are storing user data in Azure and using Azure MFA.
Customer data access is restricted to authorized individuals, requiring private credentials and access is granted only when a legitimate business requirement is demonstrated.
We rigorously prevent XSS attacks through strict input validation and up-to-date library usage.
Copy Files Pro authorizes requests using token-based authentication, requiring valid, app-signed tokens to maintain strict access control and data integrity.

In the event of a data breach with potential impact on monday.com, we will provide immediate notification through email and other appropriate channels. We are committed to transparent collaboration, working in close partnership with monday.com to expedite breach resolution and minimize data leakage.

We host and manage our servers on Microsoft Azure, ensuring a secure environment. We implement regular security updates and API key rotations to protect our systems. In response to emerging threats, we prioritize rapid patching and mitigation to minimize potential risks.
Account IDs are used for data separation; they are added to all entities and employed to filter all requests.

Parallax Resource Planning Lite for monday.com bridges the gap between task-level project planning and resource capacity management. Designed for teams seeking a lightweight solution to gain visibility into employee availability, workload, and capacity, this app offers a resource management solution within the familiar monday.com interface.

Built for digital service firms whose most important asset is their people and who are nimble in size. Organizations with multiple team members on various projects will benefit from seeing a holistic picture of who is available and what people are working on any given week.


Key Features & Benefits:

Task-to-Resource Planning Alignment

  • Transforms fragmented task efforts into cohesive resource plans by allocating employee time over project durations.
  • Provides a realistic view of capacity usage over time to avoid over/underutilization.

Simplified Capacity Visibility

  • Offers clear insights into employee availability and workload distribution.
  • Identifies resource gaps to mitigate bottlenecks and plan effectively for demand.

Introduction to Resource Planning

  • Enables essential planning, highlighting the value of forecasting capacity at scale.
  • Acts as a stepping stone to advanced resource management solutions like getparallax.com.

One Place to See Everything

  • Users manage projects and team resource plans in the same tool.
  • Eliminate spreadsheets and manual tracking.


How it Works:

The app simplifies resource management by enabling users to map task data—such as assignees, dates, and effort estimates—to employee resource plans, ensuring a holistic view of project and team capacity. It’s ideal for project managers, resource planners, and team leads who must balance workloads, meet deadlines, and ensure team productivity.

  1. Add the Resource Plan view to boards and schedule weekly employee project allocations.
  2. Use the Resource Schedule to view weekly capacity and track workload distribution.


Get Started Today!

Whether managing a small team or overseeing complex projects, Parallax's Resource Planning for monday.com helps you streamline your planning, optimize resource utilization, and stay ahead of demand. Get started today to take control of your team’s capacity and elevate your project planning process!

While DocuDraw doesn't have separate HIPAA certification, it operates entirely within the monday.com environment and leverages monday.com's security infrastructure. If monday.com has implemented a HIPAA-compliant environment for the customer, DocuDraw doesn't introduce additional infrastructure or data storage outside of this environment. However, we recommend healthcare organizations consult with their compliance officers before using DocuDraw for protected health information.

While DocuDraw doesn't have a separate SOC 2 or SOC 3 certification, it operates entirely within the monday.com environment. We leverage monday.com's security infrastructure, which maintains SOC 2 compliance. DocuDraw doesn't introduce additional infrastructure or data storage outside of monday.com's certified environment.

While DocuDraw doesn't have a separate GDPR certification, it operates entirely within the monday.com environment. We leverage monday.com's GDPR-compliant infrastructure and data processing practices. DocuDraw doesn't collect, process, or store personal data outside of monday.com's environment, ensuring that your data governance remains consistent with monday.com's GDPR compliance framework.

DocuDraw implements proper encoding and sanitization for all user-supplied content from both the text editor and whiteboard components. We use standard sanitization libraries to escape potentially harmful characters and strip any executable code, ensuring that text and visual elements are displayed safely without creating security vulnerabilities when viewed by other users.

DocuDraw doesn't require specific CSRF protection because all data-saving actions occur through monday.com's own security system. We don't process any data outside of monday.com's environment or use our own servers. Instead, we rely entirely on monday.com's built-in security measures and permission system, which already includes protection against these types of attacks. Yes. We operate the app in a GDPR-aligned manner and apply privacy-by-design principles. In practice, the app does not store or persist customer content in our systems, and we do not transfer customer data outside the monday.com environment; access to any sensitive analytics content remains governed by the customer’s Looker authentication and permissions.
Where personal data may be processed as part of the customer’s use of monday.com/Figma, we limit processing to what is necessary to provide the service and support GDPR expectations (data minimization, access controls, and incident notification procedures). Additionally, we do not use any third-party “session replay” tools or external loggers that capture user screens, keystrokes, or customer data.

Yes. For our own employee access to systems that may process customer data (for example, cloud infrastructure, source control, and administrative tooling), we require multi-factor authentication (MFA) and enforce least-privilege access.
For the Looker environment specifically, MFA enforcement depends on the Figma instance’s authentication configuration and is administered on the Figma side (i.e., enabled and managed by the Figma administrator). Figma documents its two-factor authentication configuration here: https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/360039817634-Enable-two-factor-authentication-2FA

Yes. We enforce least-privilege access through role-based controls, limiting employee and system access to the minimum required for operations, support, and security. Privileged access is tightly restricted, logged, and reviewed periodically, and elevated access is granted only when necessary.
In addition, we do not store or persist customer data in our systems. Sensitive content remains protected behind the customer’s Figma authentication and permissions, and we do not use session-replay or “video logger” tools that record user screens or keystrokes

Yes. The app treats all user-supplied input as untrusted and applies server-side validation plus context-aware output encoding to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). We do not render raw user input as HTML/JavaScript; if any rich text is ever supported, it is sanitized using an allowlist approach.
Because the app is embedded, additional browser isolation controls apply. For the Figma integration specifically, rendering and XSS protections within embedded Figma content are primarily handled by Figma and are outside our direct control.

Yes. All state-changing actions are protected against CSRF using standard controls appropriate to the request type—such as anti-CSRF tokens for browser-based flows and enforcing SameSite cookie settings where cookies are used.
In addition, we validate authentication and apply request integrity checks (for example, Origin/Referer validation where applicable) to prevent unauthorized cross-site requests from triggering actions on a user’s behalf.
Because the app is embedded, some session and request protections are also provided by the embedding platform. For Figma-related actions, CSRF protections for embedded Looker workflows are primarily handled by Figma and are outside our direct control.

Yes. We have an incident response process that includes defined escalation and notification procedures. We also maintain internal logging and investigation workflows to support timely triage, communication, and resolution

Yes. We have a documented patch and update process for application dependencies and underlying infrastructure (including software packages and databases). We monitor for security advisories, prioritize remediation based on severity and exposure, and deploy updates through a controlled release workflow (testing, staged rollout, and rollback capability).
Critical security patches are expedited, and updates are tracked to completion to ensure the service remains current and supported.

Yes. Customer data is segregated logically by monday.com’s account/workspace boundaries and access controls, so one customer cannot access another customer’s data.
In addition, we do not store or persist customer data in our own systems, which further reduces the risk of cross-customer data exposure outside the monday.com environment.

Security & Privacy Contact: Serena Hagen (Data Protection Officer) serena@<satisfactiondrivers.com>. Please remove "<" & ">" before sending email.

Yes. We operate the app in a GDPR-aligned manner and apply privacy-by-design principles. The app is designed to minimize data processing and does not persist customer design content within our own systems beyond operational requirements necessary to provide the integration.
Access to Canva content remains governed by the customer’s Canva authentication and sharing permissions. We implement appropriate access controls, data minimization practices, and incident response procedures consistent with GDPR expectations.
We also maintain a dedicated privacy contact, Serena Hagen (Data Protection Officer, Serena@<satisfactiondrivers.com>), for GDPR and privacy-related inquiries.

Yes, redirect behavior is restricted. The app does not implement user-controlled redirects or forwarding to arbitrary external destinations. Any external navigation is limited to approved Canva and Satisfaction Drivers resources and is presented as explicit user actions rather than automatic redirects.

For the Canva integration specifically, authentication and design access flows are handled through Canva authentication systems and are outside our direct control. We do not introduce additional redirect paths beyond what is required for the embedded Canva experience.

Yes. We protect against mass parameter assignment by accepting only explicitly allowlisted parameters and rejecting unexpected or unsupported fields. Server-side validation is enforced for all requests.

Because the app operates as an embedded monday.com integration, additional controls are also enforced by the hosting platform. For Canva-related actions, design-level permissions and authorization enforcement are primarily handled through Canva access controls.

Yes. We intentionally minimize logging and avoid storing sensitive information, including credentials, access tokens, customer design content, or personally identifiable information (PII), within application logs.

Logs are restricted to operational and technical events required for monitoring, reliability, and troubleshooting. We also do not use third-party session replay or screen capture tools that record user screens, keystrokes, or design content.

Yes. We require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for employee access to systems that may process customer data, including cloud infrastructure, administrative tooling, and source control systems. Access is additionally governed through least-privilege principles.

For Canva content and collaboration environments, MFA enforcement depends on the customer’s Canva authentication configuration and is administered by the customer’s Canva administrator or account owner.

Yes. We enforce least-privilege access controls for employee and system access to operational and support environments. Access is limited to authorized personnel and granted only when necessary for support, maintenance, or security purposes.

We do not store or persist Canva design content in our systems. Access to Canva designs remains protected through the customer’s Canva authentication and sharing permissions. Additionally, we do not use session replay or screen-recording tools that capture customer design content or user activity.

Yes. The app treats all user-supplied input as untrusted and applies validation, sanitization, and context-aware output encoding to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). We do not render raw user input as executable HTML or JavaScript.

Because the app embeds Canva content, some rendering and browser isolation protections are additionally managed by Canva and the embedding environment.

Yes. All state-changing actions are protected against CSRF using standard protections appropriate to the request flow, including anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookie protections where applicable, authentication validation, and request integrity checks such as Origin and Referer verification.

As the app operates within monday.com and integrates with Canva, certain authentication and session protections are additionally enforced by monday.com and Canva authentication systems.

Yes. We maintain an incident response and escalation process that includes notification procedures for security events impacting the app, customer data, or the monday.com platform.

If a relevant security incident occurs, we will promptly notify monday.com through the appropriate channels and provide available details regarding scope, impact, containment, mitigation, and remediation progress. Internal logging and investigation procedures are maintained to support timely response and resolution.

Yes. We maintain a documented process for managing application updates and security patches across dependencies, infrastructure, and supporting services. Security advisories are monitored continuously, patches are prioritized based on severity and exposure, and updates are deployed through controlled testing and release procedures.

Critical security updates are expedited, and deployment workflows include validation and rollback mechanisms where appropriate.

Yes. Customer data is logically segregated through monday.com account boundaries, Canva workspace permissions, and application-level access controls to prevent unauthorized cross-customer access.

Additionally, we do not maintain persistent copies of customer design content within our own infrastructure, reducing the risk of cross-customer data exposure outside the monday.com and Canva environments.

The app only performs redirects as part of the OAuth authentication flow with monday.com. All redirects are limited to approved and trusted endpoints—either monday.com or our own application. No open redirects to arbitrary destinations are allowed.

Yes, the app protects against mass assignment attacks by explicitly validating and whitelisting only the expected parameters in all API endpoints. Unexpected or unauthorized fields are ignored or rejected.

Yes, the app performs input sanitization on all user-supplied parameters using a Node.js library to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. All inputs are properly sanitized and/or encoded before rendering or processing.

App data is stored in Turso DB, a distributed SQLite database platform built on libSQL. Turso provides edge-replicated databases with encryption at rest and in transit, ensuring low-latency access and data security across multiple regions while maintaining GDPR compliance.RetryAJ

Yes. We enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for employee access to systems that may process customer data. Our team members are required to use Google Authenticator as the primary MFA method, along with mobile OTP as an additional layer of protection to further secure access.

Yes. As the sole developer of these applications, I follow the principle of least privilege by ensuring that only I have access to customer data, and only when required for development, maintenance, or support purposes. No other individuals have access.

Smart Timeline + Duration is the ultimate automation app for project-based teams. It removes the need for manual timeline setup and complex formulas by automatically generating visual timeline column and calculating task duration using advanced date logic – no formulas, no spreadsheet hacks.


Explore Product Page | Book A Demo | Chat with Us


Whether you’re planning sprints, managing deadlines, or tracking deliverables, Smart Timeline + Duration helps you visualize timelines, measure durations, and stay fully in control – all within your monday.com boards.


Key Benefits

  • Auto Timeline Column – Instantly creates a visual timeline from any Start and/or End Date.
  • Auto Duration Column – Calculates number of days automatically, no formulas needed.
  • Real-Time Sync – Timeline and duration adjust automatically when dates change.
  • Automation Recipes – Trigger alerts, status changes, or date shifts based on timeline logic.
  • Unlimited Boards & Items – Works across all your teams, projects, and departments.


Popular Use Cases

  • Project Management – Track timelines, durations, and task progress with clarity.
  • Agile Teams – Map out sprints and measure length without complex setups.
  • Marketing Campaigns – Schedule launches and track campaign lifecycles.
  • Event Planning – Plan timelines and prep windows with built-in duration logic.
  • Construction & Ops – Track task durations and prevent timeline overlaps in real time.


Need a custom automation recipe?


Contact our support team and book a free discovery call – we’ll explore the possibilities together and see what we can offer!

marketplace_apps.description:
WhatsBoard for WhatsApp

Seamlessly Connect WhatsApp with Your monday workflow.

WhatsBoard is designed to bring the power of WhatsApp messaging directly into your monday boards, helping you streamline communication, automate workflows, and boost efficiency.

With WhatsBoard, you can send and receive WhatsApp messages — including text, images, documents, and videos — without leaving your monday workspace. Whether you manage customer support, sales, or internal collaboration, WhatsBoard ensures that you stay engaged with your contacts effortlessly.


Why Choose WhatsBoard?

🔹Eliminate App Switching – Manage all your WhatsApp messages within monday.com.

🔹 Enhance Team Productivity – Assign chats, notify team members, and track responses.

🔹 Automate Conversations – Set up WhatsApp messages triggered by board events.

🔹 Improve Customer Experience – Provide faster responses with structured communication.

🔹 Track and Monitor Conversations – Know who sent what and when, ensuring accountability.

Key Features

1. Send and receive text, image, document and video messages directly from your Board.

2. Send template messages using your board columns data.

3. Automatically assign a team member to incoming chats in a round-robin fashion.

4. Notify assigned team member, on new incoming messages.

5. See which team member sent a message.

6. Automate sending a text message or template message on any changes like item moved to a group, item created, form submitted, update added etc.

If you need any help or want to see a demo, please schedule a call using this link - https://momentumapps.in/book-demo/whatsboard

Upgrade your workflow and automate your social media management & publishing pipeline, all without leaving monday.com


See it in action 👇

📽️ Watch how to preview and schedule posts directly from your board using Publisher.


🌟Key features🌟


📅 Post Calendar:

View and manage all scheduled posts in a clear calendar layout.


🖋️ Post Preview:

Customize messages per platform, add emojis, media, and hashtags, and preview exactly how each post will appear before publishing.


⏰Manual & Automated Scheduling:

Schedule posts manually for specific dates and times, or automate your workflow using monday automations for fully integrated, hands-off publishing.


🔗Complete monday integration :

Use data from your monday boards—columns, item values, and media fields—as content variables in your posts templates.


🗂️Workspace-Level Organization:

Each monday.com workspace connects to its own Publisher Space, keeping your brands, clients, assets, and schedules cleanly separated.


🛡️ Role-Based Access:

Admins, Managers, Members, and Viewers — assign roles to control access to templates, accounts, and publishing actions across your team.


✅ Built-in Approval Workflow:

Review, approve, and control posts before they go live, right inside your board.


🔍 And many more powerful features to discover.


👉Transforms your monday boards into a complete social media command center now.


💬 Start your free trial today and take the chaos out of social publishing.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: csd@innovator.atlassian.net

Redirects are all checked from an allow list of internal links such as monday.com. The app does not use a server and has the firewall enabled to prevent external communication. The client uses a strict Content Security Policy (CSP) to prevent egress.
We use allow lists and strongly typed models to update data. Everything else that is passed along to the strongly typed properties is ignored.

Our app is entirely client-side and does not store any data outside of monday.com. As a result, our team has no access to customer content—only limited logs that exclude any personally identifiable information (PII). On top of this, all staff are required to use multi-factor authentication (MFA) for access.

We use a very restrictive Content Security Policy (CSP) to significantly reduce the risk of cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. We sanitise all user supplied input with standard libraries which, for example, escape HTML tags and remove invalid input.

All state changing actions are to be accompagnied by a JWT token signed by our apps secret key. When the JWT token cannot be validated using our secret key, the request is rejected with a 401 HTTP request header.
Initial notification would be an email to appsupport@monday.com.

Automated dependency analysis is performed and flags any vulnerable or out-of-date packages for update. Critical severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >= 8, CVSS v3 score >= 9) are normally fixed within 2 weeks High severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >= 6, CVSS v3 score >= 7) are normally fixed within 3 weeks Medium severity bugs (CVSS v2 score >~= 3, CVSS v3 score >= 4) are normally fixed within 4 weeks.

By reducing storage usage, Storage Saver can help extend the lifespan of your current monday.com plan — especially for teams managing large volumes of files.

Storage Saver helps you reduce storage usage in your monday.com account by automatically offloading files from your boards to cloud storage — without losing access to them.

Time-based file offloading:

Automatically move files from a Files column to a dedicated folder in Google Drive for items that were last updated N days ago. A link to the item's folder is saved in a specified column on the board for easy access.

Trigger-based file move on column change:

Instantly move files to a Google Drive folder when they are added to a Files column. The app saves the link to the item folder in a chosen column.


These recipes help you:

  • Free up monday.com storage space
  • Keep boards lightweight and organized
  • Maintain easy access to all files via cloud links


We're actively working on:

  • Support for additional cloud storage platforms like OneDrive, Dropbox, and Box
  • New automations to offer even more flexibility and control over file management

If your monday.com storage is filling up or you want to keep your boards lean and efficient — Storage Saver is for you.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: The app is deployed using monday code, and all data is securely stored on fully compliant monday.com servers
Monday.com servers
Monday.com servers
support@fortimus.co
Our app is hosted on monday code which complies with enterprise-grade security standards, including GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2
We verify and allow redirects only to approved destinations
The app protects against mass parameter assignment attacks by explicitly permitting only trusted parameters through strong parameter filtering, ensuring that only intended attributes can be set
We ensure that application logs are free from secrets and personally identifiable information (PII). We only log account ID and automation ID for debugging purposes
We enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all employee access to systems that process customer data
We enforce the principle of least privilege, ensuring access to customer data is limited to only those who need it for their role
The app performs encoding and sanitization on all user-supplied parameters to protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), ensuring that any malicious scripts are neutralized before rendering

The app protects all state-changing actions against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) by using token-based authentication and validating request origins and domains, ensuring that only trusted sources can perform operations
We immediately notify monday.com via raising a ticket, emailing necessary personnel, and also via slack. Apart from this, we also take additional steps on our side to deactivate all user tokens

We have a defined process to regularly apply application updates and security patches, including monitoring for vulnerabilities, assessing impact, testing in staging, and validating before deployment.
We use monday.com's secure storage, where all data is separated by account, region, and compartmentalized to ensure strong data isolation and security

We don't perform any redirection on our app and we always check that the origin of the request is coming from monday.com. Also we rely on the JWT being valid and correctly signed before doing anything in our integration.

We don't store data in our databases by directly handling what is sent from the requests. Since we only store information like ID's, we won't store anything extra that an attacker can send to us. We also have validation on the payload in order to validate if we're receiving the correct type of a given field, for example if we expect a number instead of a string, etc.

All of our logs have redactor interceptors which are responsible for redacting out secrets and strings that can be related to PII data from the customer's side. We only keep ID's that help us debug in case of issues.
We use Okta to access services like AWS and other internal systems. For internal systems that have customer data, a Google Sign-on is required and in order to log into GSuite, Okta is needed.

Aircall follows a formal process to grant or revoke access to its resources. System access is based on the concepts of "least-possible-privilege" and a "need-to-know" basis to ensure that authorized access is consistent with the defined responsibilities.

For all the state-changing actions, we rely on successfully decoding the JWT signed by Monday APP Client Secret, so we know it's a valid token, we validate that on our end making sure the token is linked to a valid integration and that it's allowed to perform the subsequent actions.

We have integrated Sonar in our pipelines for all our repositories and constantly using it for checking any security vulnerability.  Also, our SRE team is constantly updating our database versions when needed. Also, we have a policy in place with the SLA to fix security issues, which is the following: - Critical: 7 days - High: 30 days - Medium: 60 days - Low: Remediation is not mandatory.

For our monday.com integration, the only data related to our customers that is stored in our backend are ID's from monday.com's side. Unlock Advanced Typeform Automations

Go beyond the native integration with powerful conditional logic, full subitem support, and complete data mapping.

✅ Sync Typeform entries directly to monday.com items and subitems.

✅ Use conditional logic to filter which entries create items.

✅ Create items based on successful payments or calculated scores.

✅ Full data mapping from any Typeform question to any monday.com column.

Why You'll Love It

You love Typeform for its beautiful forms and monday.com for its powerful work management. However, the native integration can make you feel limited. You need more control to create subitems and to filter out unqualified leads.

Our Advanced Typeform Integration is built to solve these exact problems. We improve the Typeform to monday.com workflow to give you the power and flexibility your team needs to automate smarter.

Features

💥 Powerful Conditional Triggers

Stop syncing every single entry. Our app lets you build intelligent automations that only run when your specific conditions are met.

- Based on Answers: Trigger workflows when a dropdown answer is "Yes," a text field "contains 'Urgent'," or a number is greater than 8.

- Based on Payments: Automatically create an item in your "New Orders" board only after a successful Typeform payment is received.

- Based on Scores: Qualify leads or grade quizzes by creating items only when a calculated score is above a certain threshold.

🚀 Full Subitem Support

Create subitems directly from Typeform entries, perfect for tracking individual tasks, client requests, or detailed feedback under a parent item.

🗺️ Complete Column Mapping

Map any Typeform data to any compatible monday.com column. No more missing information or manual data entry to fix mismatched fields.

Enterprise-Grade Security

Our app is built on monday.com's secure infrastructure, ensuring your data is always safe and compliant with the highest standards.

If Adaptavist is controller to the information breached (not only processor) regulatory authorities are notified, same time limits apply.  As an ISO 27001 certified Adaptavist Group has a group level incident process and a dedicated Breach Process
Manual check at time of release

In our monday.com app, we prioritize the privacy and security of our customers' data. Although we do not store data in any database, we ensure data segregation through the following methods:

Logical Segregation: We use third-party services like Sentry and Hubspot for data processing. These services provide logical segregation of data, meaning that each customer's data is isolated in its own environment and cannot be accessed by other customers. This is achieved through unique identifiers associated with each customer's data.

Anonymization: To further enhance privacy, we anonymize all data before it is processed by Sentry and Hubspot. This means that any personally identifiable information (PII) is removed or replaced with random characters. This ensures that even if a data breach were to occur, the data would be useless as it could not be traced back to any individual.

Access Control: We implement strict access control measures. Only authorized personnel with the necessary permissions can access the data. This further ensures that customer data is segregated and protected from unauthorized access.

Data Encryption: All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest. This means that even if data were intercepted, it would be unreadable without the decryption keys.

Third-Party Compliance: Our third-party service providers, Sentry and Hubspot, are compliant with various data protection regulations and standards. This ensures that they also follow best practices for data segregation and security.

In summary, while we do not physically store customer data, we ensure its segregation and protection through logical means, anonymization, access control, encryption, and by partnering with compliant third-party service providers.

Keep your boards and groups automatically in sync

Managing multiple boards and groups on monday.com often means spending time manually connecting items to keep everything aligned. Connect Sync removes that hassle by automatically syncing items from your boards or groups directly into your Connect Boards columns so you always have the right items linked.

With Connect Sync, when a new item is added to a selected board or group, it’s instantly synced to the connected item. Updates and removals are handled automatically too, so your overview boards always reflect the current state of your projects, tasks, or pipelines.


🔑 Key Features

  • Automatic syncing – New items in your selected boards or groups are automatically connected to your chosen item.
  • Group-level control – Sync items from entire boards or from specific groups only.
  • Two-way updates – Add, move, or delete items, and your connect column updates instantly.
  • Hands-free automation – Behind the scenes, Connect Sync creates and manages the necessary automations so you don’t have to.
  • One-time setup – Simply choose your connect column, select the boards/groups you want to sync, and you’re done.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Project rollups – Automatically connect project group items to an overview board item for high-level tracking.
  • Task management – Keep team tasks synced into master items without manual linking.
  • Resource planning – Aggregate multiple group items into a central view for resource allocation.
  • Client dashboards – Sync client-related tasks from different groups into a single connected item for easy reporting.

⚡ Why Connect Sync?

  • Save hours of manual linking across boards.
  • Eliminate errors and missed updates when managing multiple groups.
  • Get real-time visibility of project or task rollups in one place.

Help need? Let us know at support@kolaai.com

marketplace_apps.description:
Need to push a deadline to next Wednesday, skip weekends when counting business days, or get a heads-up before a meeting starts? 🍅 Automato has the date automation recipes your monday.com workflow is missing; whether you're managing projects, scheduling field crews, coordinating events, or running recurring billing cycles.


⏩ Advanced date pushing

Push a due date to the next Friday, pull it back 5 business days, or snap it to the second Tuesday of next month. Copy a start date to a separate deadline column and shift it forward by 10 working days automatically. You choose which days to skip (weekends, Fridays, or any custom pattern), so the result always lands on a day your team actually works. Ideal for roject managers, account managers, construction schedulers, legal teams tracking response windows, and operations teams juggling deadlines across weeks and months.


💥 Avoid double booking

When a meeting room, company vehicle, piece of equipment, or team member is already scheduled between two dates, Automato detects the conflict and raises the alarm before it becomes a problem. Works with status, people, and dropdown columns, so it fits however your team tracks resource availability, in any industry.


⏰ Take action before a date arrives

Fire a notification 10 minutes before a meeting starts, or automatically assign a team leader 1 hour before a job kicks off. When your date has no time component, the action triggers the configured duration before midnight, so it works for deadlines just as well as appointments. Perfect for field service teams, event coordinators, healthcare schedulers, and any client-facing team that needs to prepare before a date lands.


📅 Set dates to the nth of the month

Snap billing dates, review milestones, or renewal deadlines to the 1st, 15th, or last day of the month, with smart end-of-month capping so a "31st" in February doesn't break your board. Great for finance teams, SaaS operations, and HR departments managing recurring monthly cycles.


🍅 Date automations are just the start.

Automato also covers people management (auto-assign whoever made a change), subitems (set all subitem statuses in one step), and board housekeeping: stripping the (copy) suffix after duplicating items or clearing a status when an item is restored from the archive. One app, a full pantry of recipes for your entire monday.com account.


⟨ View all available automations ⟩


Craving an automation we haven't cooked up yet? Reach out to our responsive support team and we'll add it to the menu.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: The application is hosted on AWS infrastructure (us-east-1 region) and transmits data exclusively to monday.com's GraphQL API for synchronization purposes. AWS serves as the hosting provider where data is processed through Lambda functions and temporarily stored in DynamoDB and Redis cache. No customer data is transmitted to any third-party services, analytics platforms, or external systems beyond monday.com. All data transmission occurs over encrypted HTTPS connections. The application acts as a bridge between monday.com boards, with monday.com being the only external service receiving customer data. For detailed information about data processing practices, please refer to our Privacy Policy [https://lynx.b3-software.com/privacy].
AWS CloudWatch
AWS DynamoDB

The application undergoes continuous internal security testing as part of development and maintenance, including ECR automated vulnerability scanning, AWS WAF attack monitoring, CloudWatch alerting for anomalies, security-focused code reviews, and input validation testing. However, formal external penetration testing by independent third-party security firms is not currently performed on a regular basis.
contact@b3-software.com

The application minimizes redirect usage and restricts all redirects to approved monday.com domains. The OAuth flow redirects only to monday.com's authorization endpoints. The frontend React application operates within monday.com's iframe context, eliminating most redirect scenarios. No user-controlled redirects are implemented.

The application protects against mass parameter assignment by using strongly-typed data structures that explicitly define which fields can be accepted from API requests. Similar to a form with predefined fields, users cannot add or modify fields that aren't explicitly defined in the application. All inputs are validated against a whitelist of allowed fields and data types before any operations occur.

The application implements environment-aware logging with automatic PII redaction in production environments. All logs contain only system identifiers (Account ID, Board ID, Item ID, Column IDs) and never include user-generated content, secrets, or personally identifiable information.

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for all employee access to production systems and AWS infrastructure. This includes AWS Console access, GitHub repository access, and any systems that process or store customer data.

The application implements least privilege access through multiple layers: JWT-based authentication with role validation, Lambda function-specific IAM roles with minimal permissions, account ID validation at every access point, and monday.com API token scoping. Each component has only the permissions necessary for its specific function.

The application implements comprehensive XSS protection through multi-layered input validation and sanitization. Frontend uses DOMPurify for HTML sanitization, while backend employs strict input validation with XSS pattern detection. AWS WAF with OWASP Core Rule Set provides an additional network-layer defense against known XSS attack patterns. All user-supplied data and monday.com API responses are sanitized before display or storage.

The application is protected against CSRF attacks through its API-based architecture using JWT bearer token authentication, following OWASP CSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet recommendations for token-based APIs. All state-changing operations require valid JWT tokens in the Authorization header, which cannot be automatically sent by browsers in cross-origin scenarios. The application does not use cookie-based authentication, eliminating the primary CSRF attack vector.
The development team has established communication channels and processes to notify monday.com of any security incidents.

The application uses AWS managed services for automatic security patching and implements a systematic deployment process with automated security scanning. Infrastructure components receive automatic security patches from AWS. Application code updates are deployed through an automated build process with vulnerability scanning and deployment gates.

Customer data is logically segregated using AWS DynamoDB with account-based partitioning. Each customer's data is isolated using unique partition keys (Account ID), ensuring strict data boundaries. All database queries, cache operations, and API requests enforce account-level isolation, preventing cross-customer data access.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer: The app is hosted on monday code, which is compliant with ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

The app only sends data outside of monday.com to user-specified Microsoft Teams channels/chats as a core functionality.

Data sent includes both:

Customer-submitted data: board names, group names, item names, subitem names, update text, column titles, and column values

Non-customer-submitted data: monday account slug, board IDs, group IDs, item IDs, subitem IDs, and update IDs

The data is transmitted directly to Microsoft Teams and is not stored or sent to any other third-party services.
Logs data is kept in monday code’s managed logging service.
The app stores account metadata (account ID, start/renewal dates, and quota) and conditional logic for sentence recipes in monday's key-value storage.

Our application runs entirely within monday.com's infrastructure, which undergoes penetration testing as part of their SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance programs. We do not conduct separate penetration testing.
Yes. All security and privacy inquiries can be sent to security@interactidigital.com
The app is hosted on monday code, which is compliant with HIPAA requirements.
The app is hosted on monday code, which maintains SOC 2 and SOC 3 certifications.
We are compliant with GDPR.

Yes, the app restricts redirects exclusively to approved destinations: graph.microsoft.com and login.microsoftonline.com during OAuth flows. We enforce this using monday.com's Network Allowlist feature, which limits all outbound traffic to pre-approved endpoints only.
The app only accepts requests from monday.com and Microsoft Graph API. All endpoints validate request origins, sanitize incoming data, and reject unexpected fields to prevent mass-assignment attacks.
We do not log tokens, secrets, or any personally identifiable information (PII) in our application logs.
Yes. Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all access to internal systems that may process customer data. Google Workspace MFA and email 2FA are used.

We do not store any monday.com board/item, or Microsoft Teams messages data. Access to the limited subscription metadata we maintain is granted exclusively to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis, following the principle of least privilege.
All user input is processed through monday.com's secure UI components. The app also performs additional server-side sanitization before processing.
All state-changing actions require a valid JWT token issued by monday.com with a 5-minute expiration. We verify this token before processing any request, providing CSRF protection.
We will notify monday.com's security team within 24 hours of any confirmed security breach.
Yes. monday.com automatically manages runtime and OS patches. We review dependency security advisories every two weeks and redeploy applications with updated versions as needed.

Yes, customer data is logically segregated. We use monday.com's storage for account metadata and automation logic. It automatically segregates data by account ID and app, ensuring each customer's data is completely isolated and inaccessible to other customers.

The Google Analytics Automations app connects your monday.com boards with Google Analytics, allowing you to send annotations and events automatically based on board activity. This integration makes your marketing, sales, and operations data more actionable by linking it to your reporting in GA.

Annotations

Create Google Analytics annotations directly from your boards:

  • Trigger annotations automatically on status changes (e.g., campaign start/end, product releases).
  • Add annotations manually with a button click for key milestones.
  • Customize color, date, title, and description.

Annotations help teams track the context behind performance changes in GA, so reporting reflects what’s happening in the business.


*To prevent spam in the Google Analytics property, unintended batched status changes are limited to a maximum of 5 annotations per minute.

Events

  • Send Google Analytics events configured in your board view.
  • Build reusable event templates with fixed values or dynamic values from board columns.
  • Dispatch events automatically on status changes.
  • Support for web and app streams, including ecommerce and advanced event types.

Events let you enrich GA with first-party data from monday.com, supporting enhanced conversions, offline conversions, and tying real-world activity back to digital reporting.

Who can use this app

  • Marketing teams: track campaigns and offline events.
  • Product teams: detect ups and downs after product release.
  • Sales teams: link CRM activity with conversions.
  • Operations teams: add context to dashboards.
  • Analysts: improve attribution and reporting accuracy.

Why use it

  • Align GA reporting with real board activity.
  • Improve conversion tracking with first-party data.
  • Automate workflows to save time and reduce manual effort.
  • Combine operational and digital data for better decisions.

Authorization

A single Admin user must authorize the app for integration between Google account and monday.com account.

With this app, monday.com board activity flows seamlessly into Google Analytics, giving teams a more complete view of performance and conversions.

Yes, redirect behavior is restricted. The app does not implement user-controlled redirects or forwarding to arbitrary external destinations. Yes. We protect against mass parameter assignment by accepting only explicitly allowlisted parameters and rejecting unexpected or unsupported fields. Server-side validation is enforced for all requests.

Yes. We intentionally minimize logging and avoid storing sensitive information, including credentials, access tokens, exported document contents, attached file contents, or personally identifiable information (PII), within application logs wherever possible.

Yes. All state-changing actions are protected against CSRF using standard protections appropriate to the request flow, including anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookie protections where applicable, authentication validation, and request integrity checks such as Origin and Referer verification.

As the app operates entirely within monday.com, certain authentication and session protections are additionally enforced by monday.com infrastructure.

Yes. We maintain an incident response and escalation process that includes notification procedures for security events impacting the app, customer data, or the monday.com platform.

If a relevant security incident occurs, we will promptly notify monday.com through the appropriate channels and provide available details regarding scope, impact, containment, mitigation, and remediation progress. Internal logging and investigation procedures are maintained to support timely response and resolution.

Yes. We maintain a documented process for managing application updates and security patches across dependencies, infrastructure, and supporting services. Security advisories are monitored continuously, patches are prioritized based on severity and exposure, and updates are deployed through controlled testing and release procedures.

Critical security updates are expedited, and deployment workflows include validation and rollback mechanisms where appropriate.

Yes. Customer data is logically segregated through monday.com account boundaries and application-level access controls to prevent unauthorized cross-customer access.

Exported board content and generated PDFs are processed only within the context of the authenticated customer workspace, reducing the risk of cross-customer data exposure.

If your monday.com boards have gotten wide, you know the problem. You're scrolling sideways to find columns, hiding fields just to see what you need, and new teammates take one look at the board and have no idea where to start.


Column Groups adds a dedicated board view that lets you organize columns into labeled, color-coded groups, collapse the ones you don't need right now, and actually see your board without the noise.


Your main table view stays completely untouched. This all happens in a separate board view, so nothing about your underlying board changes.


What you can do

Group related columns together

  • Organize columns into named vertical groups, things like customer info, project tracking, internal notes, or whatever makes sense for your workflow. Wide boards become scannable in seconds instead of minutes.

Collapse and expand column groups

  • Hide the columns you only need occasionally and bring them back when you do. One click, no permanent changes, no hiding columns for everyone on every view.

Color-code your groups

  • Apply color to column groups to visually separate categories, phases, or workflows. Really useful when you're in a board review or walking a new teammate through how the board is structured.

Different groupings per item group

  • Set up different column arrangements for different item groups on the same board. If you're running a multi-phase project where each stage surfaces different information, this is the feature that makes that work.


Shared across the team

The layout you set up in Column Groups applies to everyone who opens that view. So when you spend 20 minutes organizing a messy board, the whole team gets a cleaner experience, not just you.


Built for boards that have grown up

Monday.com boards tend to accumulate columns over time, integrations, forms, tracking fields, metadata that made sense at the time. Column Groups doesn't fight that. It just gives you a view that handles it.


Column Groups is actively developed and updated based on feedback from real teams working with large, complex boards. If something's missing or not quite right for your setup, I want to hear about it.


Questions before you install? Reach out at support@asplundsoftware.com, I'm happy to help.

compliance_answers.detailedAnswer:
MeetVista sends limited data outside of monday.com only to its own backend services, hosted securely on Amazon Web Services (AWS) within EU regions (Stockholm).

Customer-submitted data: board names, item names, column values, and other user-generated content needed to display and synchronize the visual workspace.

Non-customer-submitted data: monday.com account ID, board ID, item ID, and user ID — used strictly for authentication, data linkage, and synchronization.
MeetVista stores all application and system logs securely within Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure.
MeetVista stores all application data securely on Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, hosted in EU regions to ensure GDPR compliance and data residency within the EU/EEA.

MeetVista is compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

MeetVista provides users with all GDPR rights, including data access, rectification, and erasure (right to be forgotten).
Upon app uninstallation, all customer data and metadata are permanently deleted, with backups cycled out within 10 days.
MeetVista follows AWS’s GDPR-compliant infrastructure to ensure secure data handling and storage.

MeetVista restricts all redirects and forwards to approved, internal destinations only.
MeetVista does not redirect or forward to URLs outside its own domain or trusted subdomains.

MeetVista is protected against mass parameter assignment attacks through strict input validation, schema enforcement, and controlled data mapping.
All incoming requests are validated using schemas on both the client and server side, ensuring only explicitly allowed fields are processed. The backend uses ORM defined model attributes and whitelisted fields to prevent unintended data binding or property injection.
MeetVista ensures that application logs never contain secrets or personally identifiable information (PII).

All employee accounts that access systems processing customer data are protected by Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
Access to infrastructure requires MFA and is restricted to authorized personnel only.

Access to customer data is strictly controlled based on the principle of least privilege. Each system component, service, and user is granted only the minimum permissions necessary to perform its intended function.

MeetVista performs input validation, encoding, and sanitization on all user-supplied data.
All text and HTML inputs are validated using schemas and sanitized. ORM-level schemas are used to enforce type safety, reject malformed or unexpected fields. Uploaded files are validated for type.

MeetVista protects all state-changing requests against CSRF using a double-submit cookie pattern. Each request must include a CSRF token that matches the session cookie, validated server-side before execution.

Application dependencies are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities during continuous integration (CI). Critical updates are applied promptly based on severity. All infrastructure runs on AWS, where managed services and instances receive routine security patches.
