marketplace_app_features.name: Forecast
marketplace_app_features.description:
Transform your historical board data into actionable future insights instantly. The Forecast widget brings advanced predictive analytics to your monday.com boards, empowering sales and planning teams to anticipate revenue, volume, and capacity trends without writing a single line of code.

Unlock the power of your data with these key benefits:

- Stop guessing, start planning: Move beyond gut feelings. We use proven statistical algorithms (Holt-Winters) to detect seasonality and trends in your historical data, projecting them into the future.
- Manage risk with confidence: Visualize the future using dynamic line charts that include uncertainty bands. Adjust confidence levels (from 80% to 99%) to compare conservative versus optimistic scenarios instantly.
- Deep dive analysis: Don't settle for high-level averages. Filter your forecast by status or date ranges to isolate specific products, teams, or segments.
- Executive-ready reporting: Need exact numbers? Toggle the forecast table to see predicted values alongside upper and lower bounds. Group results by week, month, or quarter for a clear overview.
- Simple setup: Select your time column (X-axis) and value column (Y-axis), choose your granularity, and set your horizon (1–100 periods). It works natively with your existing number and formula columns.

Real-world use Cases:

Sales teams: Project next quarter's revenue based on the last two years of seasonality to set realistic quotas.
Inventory managers: Predict stock demand for upcoming holidays to prevent shortages or overstocking.
Resource planning: Anticipate support ticket volume spikes to ensure you have enough staff scheduled for busy periods.
Technical specifications: This app utilizes the Holt-Winters exponential Smoothing statistical algorithm to generate time-series forecasts.

marketplace_app_features.name: Field Service
marketplace_app_features.description:
Manage service tickets effortlessly from the office or the field. This field service template gives you a complete system to capture requests, assign ownership, and track every job from intake to completion, whether your team is in the office or in the field. marketplace_app_features.name: Get template in numbered list , generate and autosend  document
marketplace_app_features.description:
This skills consists of three tools that work together to first get the templates available in numbered format list then generate document based on the template that user tells to , then finally send the documents to signer’s email and get lists of the emails


Tools:
1. Get templates tool : Fetches all the templates for the given boardId and itemId. Each template includes templateId and template name. The template response must be shown in a numbered format .
2. Generate document tool : Generates the documents based on the template name that the user specifies then upload it to the Monday board items's file column
3. Send document tool: Sends the documents to the signers email and return the list of emails that the documents are sent to

**Critical**
When the Get templates tool gets called successfully , follow up with a question to the user to select the template number to generate document and attach it to file column 
Example: “Please enter the template number that you want to generate document and attach it to file column”


**Important**
The list of templates should be listed in numbered format. 

**Important**
Do not use bullet point to show the list of templates

Required inputs for get template tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId

Required inputs for generate document tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId
3. ItemName
4. TemplateId
5. TemplateName
6. FileId

Required inputs for generate document tool:
1. BoardId
2. ItemId

Pass the templateName as input that the user chooses. Also pass fileId and templateId as input when calling the generate document tool

The goal is to allow users to dynamically pick a template and generate a document that is then automatically attached to the relevant Monday.com item's file column and also send the documents to signer emails and show the emails that the document was sent to

marketplace_app_features.description: Smart Spreadsheet app helps to import a board or any Excel-like file into a spreadsheet and visualize, filter data, perform advanced calculations, and work with large tables within a spreadsheet. You can easily integrate it into your documents and add it as a board view, item view, custom object, or dashboard.
